intersections.note: Beekman (40 ft) runs from Harrison's east face to the right (north on this rotated sheet); west of Harrison are lots 1501/1465 and the A-B match line

Brighton (40 ft) ends at Beekman's south face; its west face is at x 6314, its east face is not drawn (at the paper edge), so the centre is taken 20 ft east of the west face. Beekman's north face runs on past Brighton
Prospect (40 ft) ends at Hiawatha where Hiawatha bends from its 40 ft north-south section into its 60 ft diagonal section; point is the centre of the small triangle formed by the three centrelines
Meader (30 ft) ends at the SW face of the 60 ft diagonal section of Hiawatha
Ernst (40 ft) ends at the SW face of Hiawatha; the Ernst water pipe turns down Hiawatha at this point
Hiawatha (60 ft) ends at Harrison's west side; the Hiawatha 4 in. pipe meets the Harrison 10 in. pipe here. The brewery TUNNEL (dashed) crosses under Harrison just north of it

State Av. (60 ft) comes from the left (south on this sheet) and ends at Harrison; Harrison turns here toward the Mill Creek bridge (the 14 in. W.P. leaves the junction to the lower right). Fire alarm box 66 just NW of the point. Same crossing is grazed at the top edge of sheet 491

widths.note: 60 ft on the diagonal section from Prospect to Harrison; 40 ft on the north-south section and its NW leg toward sheet 504

bends.note: north-south section turns to run up-left (NW on the sheet) to the top edge and onto sheet 504
angle point: steeper section toward Hiawatha, flatter section toward the left edge and sheet 491
Harrison is straight and nearly vertical from the top edge to here, then turns down-left
gentle curve between Hiawatha and State Av.: centreline lies about 38 px right of the straight line between the two junctions
Brighton turns from nearly vertical to run down-right to the C.H.&D. railroad

ends.note: west end of Meader at a lot line (lots 1386/1389); does not reach Prospect or the left edge
Brighton's faces stop at the C.H.&D. railroad tracks

notes: Sheet is drawn rotated: north points to the right (about 17 deg above horizontal), so the top of the sheet is west. One panel only: no inset or separately framed part was found anywhere on the sheet (checked all four quarters and the edges); the dash-dot lines are sheet-match lines, A-B along the top toward sheet 504 and C-D at the lower left toward sheet 491. Names as printed: HARRISON AV., BEEKMAN, BRIGHTON, HIAWATHA, PROSPECT, MEADER, ERNST ST., STATE AV.; Street/Avenue added where no suffix is printed (key map: Prospect Av.). Harrison (75 ft) runs from the top edge (x about 4660-5130) down the right-centre of the sheet, curving down-left past Hiawatha to State Av. at the bottom; the label THE HERANCOURT BREWING CO. lies in Harrison's roadway. Hiawatha enters at the top edge (40 ft, NW leg), bends at (2575,696), runs north-south to Prospect, then as a 60 ft diagonal to Harrison. Ernst/State Av.: the junction centre is off the left edge of this sheet (about x -245, y 7385; drawing stops at x 160) and is picked on sheet 491. Unnamed road, upper left (block 1): a band about 50 ft wide with no label, from the top-left (faces start at 190,370 and 140,1050) running down to a bend at about (750,2250), then off the left edge at y 2300-2650; it meets no named street on this sheet, so no intersection is recorded. The C.C.&L. R.R. (on trestle) and the C.H.&D. R.R. are ignored; KEG RUN is a covered runway, not a street.
